evidence.title: Customer Success Engineer (Internship)
evidence.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a six-month internship based in Munich or Cologne. This is an in-person role. You learn this job by sitting next to people who already do it, and that does not work remotely.

About The Role

Think of this role as the modern Sherlock Holmes — new puzzles to solve and new people to work with, every single day.

This role sits exactly at the intersection of technology and business, and that is not a figure of speech. On one side you are in the system, in the data, working out what actually happened. On the other you are on a call with a finance team explaining it and agreeing what to do. You need both, every day.

Our customers run their finance and supply chain processes on blp. When something does not behave the way they expected, a document that did not post, an exception that should have resolved itself, a number in a dashboard that looks wrong, they write to us. That is where your work starts, and it is also where you become the face of blp for that customer. What reaches them is you: your answer, your explanation, your judgement about what to do next.

You will not be reading from a script and escalating. You investigate what the system did, what the data says and what the customer's process actually requires. You have the access and the authority to change configuration when that is the answer. And when it is not, you know who to bring in and what to give them.

The role grows with you. You start on cases where the pattern is known and someone is close by. As your expertise builds you take the harder ones, and your exposure to customers grows with it: from written answers, to calls, to being in the room when a customer wants their most pressing problem solved now.

This goes well beyond tickets. We are a fast-moving organisation and a lot of what needs to exist does not exist yet. You will take on and drive initiatives that make the whole operation scale: a recurring problem that should be solved once rather than fifty times, a piece of tooling that does not exist, a way of working that has outgrown itself. Interns here have shipped things that the team still uses.

How We Think About Ownership

You will be given real work with real consequences, early, because that is the only way anyone learns this job properly. The other half of that is judgement: explore and decide for yourself where you can, and pull someone in when something critical is on the line. Knowing which situation you are in is part of the skill, and nobody will hold it against you for asking. What matters is that you are the face of blp to that customer, and that you take that seriously.

Most of our customers work in German and you will be in front of them from early on. That is uncomfortable for about three weeks and then it is the best part of the job.

This is a real internship, not an observation post. You will be trusted with live customers quickly, with people close by while you learn.

What You'll Do


 * Answer incoming customer requests through our support channel, and be the person they hear back from.
 * Own incidents end to end: investigate, resolve, and confirm with the customer that it is actually fixed.
 * Work out why a workflow, document or posting did not behave as expected.
 * Adjust configuration where that is the right fix.
 * Recognise when a problem is bigger than one case, and hand it on with proper evidence.
 * Join customer calls to work through urgent issues directly, as your experience grows.
 * Take on initiatives beyond the queue: things that should be fixed once rather than answered repeatedly.
 * Document what you learn so the next person does not have to learn it twice.
   
   

What We're Really Looking For

We do not expect you to know ERP systems. We expect you to be the kind of person who gets to the bottom of things.


 * Curiosity – You want to know why something works, not just that it does.
 * Clear Logic – You take a messy situation apart, find the actual cause, and explain it simply.
 * Customer Nerve – You stay calm and credible with a frustrated controller on the phone, and you can say "I do not know yet, here is how I will find out."
 * Self-Driven – You close your own knowledge gaps without being told to.
 * Ownership – You see things through without someone checking, and you know when to pull someone in.
   
   

What You'll Bring


 * Enrolled in or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's in business, economics, information systems, engineering, computer science, or something adjacent. Strong candidates from other backgrounds are welcome to make their case.
 * German and English, both fluent. This is a hard requirement. Our customers work in German every day and our internal work runs in English.
 * Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with data.
 * Genuine interest in enterprise software, AI, and how large organisations actually run.
 * Nice to have, not required: first exposure to ERP systems, SQL, APIs, or process modelling.
   
   

Where it leads

Our internship is the main entry point into the delivery organisation. Interns who do well are offered a permanent role, most often as a Customer Success Engineer or as an AI Automation Specialist, and from there the paths into Consulting and into project management are well travelled. We tell you early and honestly whether that conversation is coming.

What You'll Get


 * Real responsibility from week three, not shadowing.
 * A steep learning curve on live enterprise systems.
 * Direct access to engineers, product managers, and the people running our customers' finance operations.
 * Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option programme.
 * Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.
 * Visits & offsites – including collaborative team offsites.
   
   

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

evidence.title: Mechatronics Design Intern - Hardware Grasshopper wanted (m/f/d)
evidence.description:
Your mission

Robots couldn't handle soft materials. We fixed that.

Now we're scaling it into reality, and we need the sharpest engineering minds: the ones who turn breakthrough ideas into machines that hold up.

At sewts, we build the intelligence that lets robots manipulate deformable materials — textiles, towels, cables — with human-like precision. Our systems are already deployed in production across Europe and expanding into the US.

We are building a foundational technology stack called sewts.JUPITER. JUPITER uses genAI to realistically simulate the behavior of deformable and soft objects, creating the computer vision models and grasping strategies behind our machines. Based on our physical AI, for the first time ever, robots can handle soft and deformable materials. With over €10M in funding, we will bring automation into untapped industries: cloth manufacturing, textiles handling, recycling, and e-commerce.

This is where AI leaves the screen and enters the physical world.

And in the physical world, nothing forgives you.


 * WHAT YOU'LL BUILD
 * Industrial robot cells— you design and develop them from early concept to production-ready system.
 * The engineering behind the machine: calculations for motors, conveyors, and pneumatics, and the selection of the right robots for the job
 * Fast prototypes: turn new ideas into working solutions you can test, break, and improve.
 * Engineering data the whole team can rely on: CAD models, drawings, versions. You own it.
   
   

Your profile

What You'll Bring


 * A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
 * 2+ years in product design and development, ideally in robotics or automation.
 * Solid CAD skills — we work with Inventor and SolidWorks.
 * A hands-on, tinkerer's mindset: you love building machines, tools, and processes that make automation happen.
 * A proactive, independent way of working, with real ownership over what you build.
 * Fluent English; German is a plus.
   
   

NICE TO HAVES


 * Experience with electrical or pneumatic design.
 * Exposure to PLM tools or CAD version-control practices.
 * A background in robotics, automotive, or the textile/laundry industry.
   
   

Please note: you don't need to tick every box. We're looking for motivated people excited to grow into the role.

WHY THIS ROLE


 * Direct, visible impact: every system you design ends up running live, keeping robots working reliably in the field.
 * You build technology that has never existed before — mechanical systems for physical AI.
 * Real responsibility from day one: you own your designs end-to-end, from first sketch to production line.
 * A team that respects craft. The engineers who design and build systems that actually hold up are never an afterthought here.
 * Grow with us as we scale across Europe — your designs are at the core of that expansion.
 * Munich-based, with the chance to see your work in action at customer sites across Europe.
   
   

Why us?

Setup & Benefits


 * Competitive salary + VSOP participation.
 * Learning budget + fast growth environment.
 * Deutschlandticket + EGYM Wellpass.
 * Speciality coffee at the office.
 * Flexible working setup.
 * Regular team events, high trust, low bureaucracy.
   
   

REALITY CHECK

Deformable materials are unpredictable, parts wear down under real loads, and sometimes the fix isn't in any manual — it's you, hands-on, figuring it out on the spot. If you need a clean workshop and a fully predictable schedule, this probably isn't the right fit. If you get energy from building things that actually hold up in the real world, and love being the one who makes it work: welcome to sewts.

About Us

At sewts we are automating complex processes by teaching robots human-like perception skills. We are a young, ambitious, and diverse team of eight different nationalities with the mission to become the global go-to Partner for automated processing of deformable and soft materials. We are always willing to push our boundaries to reach our goals and targets, while learning from the daily challenges of an emerging startup. We are always on a hunt for likeminded individuals who are passionate about robotics automation, AI and courageous to create an impact.

Are you ready?

Your mission:

Become a part of the 4screen team!

As a Business Ops Intern – People & Culture at 4screen, you will support our team across the full employee lifecycle – from recruiting and onboarding to offboarding and beyond. You'll help optimize P&C processes, support P&C administration and contract creation, and strengthen our company culture through initiatives like team events and employer branding. In addition, you'll support taking care of our office environment, ensuring it remains a welcoming space for collaboration and wellbeing. As part of our broader Business Operations team, you'll also gain exposure to various cross-functional projects along the way, gaining valuable insights into a dynamic and innovative workplace.

How you contribute to our success:


 * Supporting recruiting and hiring: You help manage job boards, monitor and respond to our recruiting inbox, and support candidates through the hiring process, including efforts to streamline our recruitment process.
 * Shaping onboarding and offboarding: You own key parts of the onboarding and offboarding admin process, keep our onboarding materials up to date, support exit interviews, and help create employment references.
 * Driving P&C administration and contracts: You support contract creation, help optimize internal and company-wide processes using AI and automation, and help collect and maintain personnel data in our P&C system (Personio).
 * Strengthening employee experience and culture: You contribute to internal communication formats and employer branding and help organize regular team and company initiatives that strengthen cohesion and team spirit.
 * Managing our office: You support day-to-day office management and help shape an office environment where the team feels comfortable and our culture is visible – bringing your own ideas to make it a hub for collaboration.
 * Drive cross-functional projects: You support cross-functional projects, building skills in project planning, stakeholder management, and communication, with insight into how Business Operations functions end-to-end at a scale-up.
   
   

What makes you stand out:


 * Completed or ongoing Master's degree, ideally in Business, Economics, or a related field
 * A genuine interest in processes, projects, and how People & Culture functions
 * Availability for a 6-month internship, with in-office presence 3-4 days per week
 * Excellent German and English skills (at least B2+)
 * Previous internship or working student experience in HR or Operations (ideally in consulting, start-up, tech, or automotive) is a plus
 * Curiosity about AI and the drive to use it to boost your productivity
 * Structured and independent working style, with strong attention to detail
 * Hands-on and can-do mindset, comfortable owning administrative and operational tasks alongside project work
 * Strong communication skills, initiative and an open and approachable manner
 * A true team player with curiosity and eagerness to learn
   
   

What we offer you:


 * Gain firsthand experience in a dynamic and professional startup setting
 * Participating actively in crucial People & Culture processes and acquiring knowledge of best practices from top notch professionals
 * Relax during your 20 days of annual leave (+ public holidays)
 * Take care of your well-being with the support of our Egym Wellpass membership
 * Enjoy our flexible working hours policy in our open office in Munich’s vibrant Schwabing district
 * Have fun and enjoy the great team spirit at regular Team Events & Offsites, Pizza Nights, Game Nights, etc.
   
   

We stand for equal opportunity for everyone and value diversity. Therefore, we encourage an open and inclusive work environment where you can be exactly who you are.

We truly believe that individual strengths and personalities make a great contribution to our success story. Hence, even if you don’t fulfill all the points above but believe that you are a great addition to our team and 4screen is a place you’d love to work at, we can only encourage you to apply!

4screen is the world’s first Driver Interaction Platform, connecting brands & businesses with on-the-go customers in real time – directly through the car screen. By operating within the vehicle’s native digital interface, 4screen leverages dynamic car data to enhance the mobility experience – all in full compliance with the highest safety and privacy standards. 4screen is integrated into the operating systems of 16 leading automotive brands, including Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Volkswagen, Toyota, Kia, Hyundai, and Stellantis. Today, more than 100 brands – including McDonald’s, Shell, and Waitrose – across 12 countries are already using the platform to reach drivers in meaningful, high-intent moments.

Our team at 4screen consists of a mix of young talents and industry experts who have previously been in leading positions at companies like BMW, Google or BCG. We are building a highly innovative company where everything is dynamic, disruptive, and exciting - and that you can be part of!

Are you ready to join the ride and shape the future of mobility?

evidence.title: Customer Success Engineer (Internship)
evidence.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a six-month internship based in Munich or Cologne. This is an in-person role. You learn this job by sitting next to people who already do it, and that does not work remotely.

About The Role

Think of this role as the modern Sherlock Holmes — new puzzles to solve and new people to work with, every single day.

This role sits exactly at the intersection of technology and business, and that is not a figure of speech. On one side you are in the system, in the data, working out what actually happened. On the other you are on a call with a finance team explaining it and agreeing what to do. You need both, every day.

Our customers run their finance and supply chain processes on blp. When something does not behave the way they expected, a document that did not post, an exception that should have resolved itself, a number in a dashboard that looks wrong, they write to us. That is where your work starts, and it is also where you become the face of blp for that customer. What reaches them is you: your answer, your explanation, your judgement about what to do next.

You will not be reading from a script and escalating. You investigate what the system did, what the data says and what the customer's process actually requires. You have the access and the authority to change configuration when that is the answer. And when it is not, you know who to bring in and what to give them.

The role grows with you. You start on cases where the pattern is known and someone is close by. As your expertise builds you take the harder ones, and your exposure to customers grows with it: from written answers, to calls, to being in the room when a customer wants their most pressing problem solved now.

This goes well beyond tickets. We are a fast-moving organisation and a lot of what needs to exist does not exist yet. You will take on and drive initiatives that make the whole operation scale: a recurring problem that should be solved once rather than fifty times, a piece of tooling that does not exist, a way of working that has outgrown itself. Interns here have shipped things that the team still uses.

How We Think About Ownership

You will be given real work with real consequences, early, because that is the only way anyone learns this job properly. The other half of that is judgement: explore and decide for yourself where you can, and pull someone in when something critical is on the line. Knowing which situation you are in is part of the skill, and nobody will hold it against you for asking. What matters is that you are the face of blp to that customer, and that you take that seriously.

Most of our customers work in German and you will be in front of them from early on. That is uncomfortable for about three weeks and then it is the best part of the job.

This is a real internship, not an observation post. You will be trusted with live customers quickly, with people close by while you learn.

What You'll Do


 * Answer incoming customer requests through our support channel, and be the person they hear back from.
 * Own incidents end to end: investigate, resolve, and confirm with the customer that it is actually fixed.
 * Work out why a workflow, document or posting did not behave as expected.
 * Adjust configuration where that is the right fix.
 * Recognise when a problem is bigger than one case, and hand it on with proper evidence.
 * Join customer calls to work through urgent issues directly, as your experience grows.
 * Take on initiatives beyond the queue: things that should be fixed once rather than answered repeatedly.
 * Document what you learn so the next person does not have to learn it twice.
   
   

What We're Really Looking For

We do not expect you to know ERP systems. We expect you to be the kind of person who gets to the bottom of things.


 * Curiosity – You want to know why something works, not just that it does.
 * Clear Logic – You take a messy situation apart, find the actual cause, and explain it simply.
 * Customer Nerve – You stay calm and credible with a frustrated controller on the phone, and you can say "I do not know yet, here is how I will find out."
 * Self-Driven – You close your own knowledge gaps without being told to.
 * Ownership – You see things through without someone checking, and you know when to pull someone in.
   
   

What You'll Bring


 * Enrolled in or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's in business, economics, information systems, engineering, computer science, or something adjacent. Strong candidates from other backgrounds are welcome to make their case.
 * German and English, both fluent. This is a hard requirement. Our customers work in German every day and our internal work runs in English.
 * Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with data.
 * Genuine interest in enterprise software, AI, and how large organisations actually run.
 * Nice to have, not required: first exposure to ERP systems, SQL, APIs, or process modelling.
   
   

Where it leads

Our internship is the main entry point into the delivery organisation. Interns who do well are offered a permanent role, most often as a Customer Success Engineer or as an AI Automation Specialist, and from there the paths into Consulting and into project management are well travelled. We tell you early and honestly whether that conversation is coming.

What You'll Get


 * Real responsibility from week three, not shadowing.
 * A steep learning curve on live enterprise systems.
 * Direct access to engineers, product managers, and the people running our customers' finance operations.
 * Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option programme.
 * Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.
 * Visits & offsites – including collaborative team offsites.
   
   

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

evidence.description:
Summary
At Apple, we work every day to craft products that enrich people’s lives. Do you love working on challenges that no one has solved yet? Do you like changing the game? We have an opportunity for a forward-thinking and unusually creative IC Designer.

Description
We are looking for an analog/mixed-signal IC design engineer with in-depth knowledge of state-of-the-art analog IC design & verification tools. As a member of our dynamic group, you will have the rare and exciting opportunity to craft upcoming products that will delight and encourage millions of Apple’s customers every single day.

Our AMS team works on state-of-the-art analog front-end and data converter IPs.

Responsibilities

 * As Analog IC Design Intern you will support investigations of advanced circuit architectures or design methodologies and benchmark them against existing solutions. You will gain insight in industry standard IC design tools and methodologies, and experience in analog design in advanced CMOS technologies.
   
   

Minimum Qualifications

 * Deep knowledge of transistor level design
 * Knowledge of schematic design and validation methodology using Cadence Virtuoso
 * Solid understanding of analog/mixed-signal circuit blocks such as ADCs, DACs, PLLs, filters, bandgap references, biasing circuits, LDO regulators, OpAmps, comparators and switched-cap circuits
 * Deep knowledge of analog/mixed-signal design techniques such as small-signal analysis, feedback loop theory and noise analysis
 * Deep knowledge of analog/mixed-signal concepts such as stability, linearity, mismatch mitigation, low-power and low-noise techniques
 * Experience with Matlab or Python is a plus
 * Experience in the architectural design and system-level modeling of a complete analog/mixed-signal subsystem (e.g. as part of a PhD thesis) is a strong plus
 * Fluent in English
   
   

Preferred Qualifications

 * Currently enrolled in PhD degree program in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or equivalent.

Because to create products that serve everyone, we believe in including everyone. Therefore, we are committed to treating all applicants fairly and equally. We will work with applicants to make any reasonable accommodations.

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

evidence.title: Business & Data Analyst - B2B2C
evidence.description:
About Us
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform - including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in-house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses - 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.


We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally, enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.


1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million, we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own  aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.


Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs, Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.



Position Overview
We are looking for a Business & Data Analyst to support our B2B2C business by turning complex commercial, operational, and product data into clear insights and decision-ready analysis.

This role sits at the intersection of data, commercial performance, and business strategy

Key Responsibilities

 * Own business and performance analysis across B2B2C products, partners, and markets
 * Analyze large datasets using SQL, Excel, and analytics tools to identify trends, risks, and opportunities
 * Build and maintain commercial and operational reports (revenue, margins, ARPU, churn, usage, onboarding KPIs, etc
 * Translate raw data into clear narratives and recommendations for senior stakeholders
 * Support pricing analysis, partner performance reviews, and business cases
 * Work closely with Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations teams to align data with business reality
 * Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and logical interpretation across reports and dashboards.
   
   
   
   
   

Requirements



Must Have

 * 4+ years of experience in data analysis, KPI reporting, or business intelligence
 * Strong SQL skills and experience working with data lakes or large datasets
 * Proficiency with BI/DWH tools (PowerBI, Looker, Tableau) and advanced Excel/Google Sheets (pivoting, modelling, complex formulas)
 * Strong analytical ability with a solid understanding of business models, value chains, and technical systems
 * Ability to navigate complex operations, understand performance drivers, and derive clear, actionable recommendations
 * Experience supporting business case development, benchmarking, or strategic analysis
 * Excellent communication skills — able to present complex insights in a simple and effective way
 * High degree of ownership, proactivity, and the ability to drive tasks end-to-end


Nice to Have

 * Telecom / MVNE / MVNO domain experience is an advantage
   
   
   

Benefits



Why 1GLOBAL?

 * Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
 * Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
 * Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
 * Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
 * Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field
 * International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
 * Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
 * Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

evidence.description:
About Us

YouLend is the preferred embedded finance platform for many of the world's leading e-commerce platforms, tech companies, and payment service providers. Our software enables partners like eBay, Amazon, Shopify, and Stripe to extend their value proposition by offering flexible financing products to their merchants under their own brand - without taking on capital risk.

Part of the leading private equity firm EQT, we have grown by more than 100% annually since 2020. While our headquarters are in London, we are present in several European countries and the US. For 2026, we are planning a massive expansion in Germany and are opening our new office in Berlin - a unique opportunity for you to join us from the very beginning.

Your Role & Impact

As part of our Credit Decision Team, you will be responsible for the credit assessment of new and existing customers applying for Merchant Cash Advances (MCAs). You will process applications from thousands of German and Danish businesses coming through our global partners.


 * In-depth Analysis: You assess repayment capacity and risk profiles by analyzing financial data, financial statements, and revenue/payment data
 * Structuring: You decide on the terms of financing offers (amount, duration, price), balancing risk with growth
 * Risk & Compliance: Using state-of-the-art third-party systems, you manage KYC checks as well as onboarding and compliance risks
 * Process Optimization: You work closely with other teams to continuously improve our risk engine and internal workflows
   
   

Requirements

Your Profile


 * Analytical Focus: You enjoy working with data and possess high attention to detail
 * Experience: Ideally, you have 1-2 years of experience in underwriting or finance; however, we also welcome highly motivated talents with a strong analytical background
 * Tech Savvy: Proficiency in Excel is a prerequisite
 * Hands-on Mentality: You are proactive, solution-oriented, and comfortable working in a dynamic environment with daily deadlines
 * Languages: You communicate confidently and professionally in German and English
   
   

Nice to Have


 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, as well as experience handling large datasets (e.g., SQL, Python, R)
 * Experience in the field of SME financing in Germany, ideally with Cash Advances
   
   

Benefits

At YouLend, we work in an environment that fosters personal responsibility and excellence. Our culture is characterized by:


 * High Performance: A highly skilled team that drives each other to peak performance through direct feedback and aligned incentive systems
 * Team Spirit: A strong, transparent culture - we stand up for one another
 * Impact: An empowered work environment where results matter
 * Agility: A data-driven way of working with a focus on speed and minimal bureaucracy
   
   

Why YouLend?

It is an exciting time to join; YouLend is an organization in the making. We are just at the beginning and growing at high speed.


 * Build-up Opportunity: You will become part of our new team in Berlin and actively help scale the German market
 * Growth & Stability: Over 100% YoY growth meets the security of the Banking Circle Group (with a banking license in Luxembourg) and the backing of EQT
 * Development: Clear career paths and an attractive salary package, including bonus or equity programs
   
   

Salary: Competitive market salary plus bonus

Location: Berlin, Germany (Office-based position)

As a manager on the Developer tools team you will lead teams working across Dev Mode, MCP, Code Connect, and more. You’ll also be responsible for helping define the future of our developer offering, very likely helping incubate and lead new product development. Developer tools is a major initiative at Figma and is spearheaded from the London office. You’ll be working on one of the most exciting areas within Figma incorporating design thinking, the latest AI developments, and open source developer tooling.

This is a full time role that can be held from our London hub or remotely in the UK.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Manage and support a team of product engineers focused on building and expanding Figma’s developer offerings, including Dev Mode, MCP, Code Connect, and more
  • Partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to coordinate work across product, design, engineering, and other functions

evidence.title: Affiliate Marketing Account Manager
evidence.description:
Purpose of position

Our Key Account Management team is looking for an Account Manager to assist in leading the affiliate programme for key brands on the platform. This is an exciting opportunity to develop your strategic, analytical, and relationship management skills while driving growth through innovative affiliate partnerships.

As the day-to-day point of contact on the Awin network, you will provide expert guidance on affiliate marketing best practices, with a particular focus on upper-funnel activity, including content publishers, influencers, and editorial partnerships. Working closely with the wider client team, you will identify opportunities to expand reach, engage new audiences, and drive both brand awareness and performance growth.

You will be responsible for developing, activating and nurturing relationships with key partners, and delivering insight-led recommendations to optimise programme performance. As an active member of the team, you will bring fresh ideas and innovative approaches to help maximise affiliate revenue while strengthening its presence across the affiliate ecosystem.

This is a hybrid role: three days per week working in the local London office, meeting clients and/or attending industry events. 


Key Tasks

  • Deliver excellent service and relationship management to clients and publishers
  • Be the internal owner of all assigned partners and be fully informed and able to provide information when required for the client
  • Generating reports and providing analysis on performance, and ensuring commentary is accurate and insightful with a view at improving activity
  • Taking ownership of and streamlining processes
  • Regular client calls and the ability to be reactive and supportive of client goals
  • Initiate and implement ideas to grow affiliate activities in line with the needs of clients and assist client and the wider Awin team in the creation of quarterly and yearly strategies
  • Producing competitor benchmarks for your clients, while proactively advising on industry trends and identifying opportunities
  • Take ownership in delivery and service level to client and pro-actively providing insight to Team Leader
  • Optimising existing publisher relationships and recruiting new and exciting publisher opportunities for advertisers within upper funnel
  • Presenting confidently, both internally and externally, on a range of topics.
  • Ensuring that you and your clients are up to date with all technology and tracking optimisations, and that all campaigns make the best use of these


Skills & Expertise

  • Up to 1+ years’ account management experience in a relevant performance marketing or affiliate marketing role
  • Enthusiastic, committed, and passionate about digital
  • Numerate with a good level of knowledge of MS Office packages including MS Excel
  • Ability to see the bigger picture and identify areas of opportunity and risk
  • Professional and with a proven track record of successful client and team relationship building, including strong networking skills
  • Seeks ownership and readily accepts accountability
  • Strong time management and organizational skills to maintain own work flow and meet deadlines
  • Confident and excellent communicator with a keen attention to detail
  • Competent and experienced with creating forecasts and justifying the rationale


Our Offer

  • Flexi-Week: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (wit one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.
  • Flexi-Office: We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid working model, designed to foster collaboration, trust, and autonomy.
  • Work Expense Contribution & Home Working Furniture: You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace at home.
  • Pension: We make regular contributions to support your retirement savings.
  • Private Medical Insurance: Comprehensive coverage for a range of health, vision and dental treatments.
  • Electric Vehicle & Cycle to Work Schemes: Save on commuting costs through tax-efficient schemes for electric vehicle leasing and bike purchase.
  • Workplace Nursery Benefit: Save on childcare costs through a salary sacrifice scheme with tax and National Insurance savings.
In addition, you’ll benefit from our global offering, including health and wellbeing initiatives, learning and development via Awin Academy, and peer-to-peer recognition programmes.

 

 

Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture.

Like all businesses, we’ve had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities.

Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world’s leading open partner ecosystem. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

Awin is part of the Axel Springer group. Learn more at axelspringer.com/en/, and explore the Axel Springer Essentials here: axelspringer.com/en/inside/the-essentials-what-we-have-adapted-and-why  

Apply now to begin the next stage of your career at a progressive company that supports both your professional and personal development.
